settings.statistic: Pearson association between frozen CF453 WD and CF459 WD edge-coefficient vectors
settings.primary_universe: all observed-measurable common frozen FCG-context edges; no CF453/CF459 coefficient threshold
settings.secondary_universe: displayed FCG edges within the same observed-measurable common set
settings.exact_primary: 24 complete CF459 lipid-vector pairing permutations, conditional on observed CF453 coefficients
settings.exact_complementary: 5040 complete CF453 lipid-vector pairing permutations, conditional on observed CF459 coefficients
settings.null_statistic: absolute coefficient-vector r, equivalent to absolute ULM at fixed edge count
settings.null_hypothesis: RNA-vector/lipid-vector independence in the permuted or null-resampled cohort; not coefficient equality
settings.bootstrap: independent empirical-marginal CF459 RNA/lipid whole-mouse vectors; fixed observed CF453 anchor; approximate null
settings.p_value_convention: exact exceedances/valid enumeration; Monte Carlo (1+exceedances)/(1+valid draws), including ties
settings.undefined_draws: undefined edge invalidates the entire frozen vector; no draw-specific edge deletion; P conditional on defined draws
settings.completion_bounds: allocate all undefined null draws to either nonexceedance or exceedance; mathematical bounds, not confidence intervals or calibrated corrections
settings.nominal_ULM: intercept OLS slope t-statistic; dependent edge residuals make nominal P descriptive
settings.paired_bootstrap: paired whole mice sampled independently within each cohort; both zones share indices; stability only
settings.loco: 28 joint omissions plus seven CF453-only and four CF459-only omissions; same mice in both zones; descriptive stability
settings.limitations: CF459 n=4; neither cohort age/background equivalence nor within-CF459 SD versus WD effects are identified
